scripts.build:
npm run typecheck && esbuild src/runtime/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=dist/broker.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run check:architecture && npm run verify:protocol && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: node dist/broker.mjs --version && node dist/broker.mjs catalog | node scripts/verify-catalog-output.mjs
